channel.title: 个人数学雷达
channel.description: 数学、形式化证明与 AI for Math；来源原文摘录及中文译文

item.title: 函数域上酉群的拉马努金猜想和黎曼猜想
item.description: We establish generic local and global Langlands functoriality, namely stable base change, for the unitary groups in characteristic $p$. Main applications are the Ramanujan Conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis for extended Langlands-Shahidi $L$-functions of the unitary groups over function fields.

item.title: 零系数 PLRS 的间隙
item.description: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? To date only the Kangaroo case, where there is a fixed $g$ such that $c_i = 1$ if $i \equiv 1 \bmod g$ and 0 otherwise, has been done and again geometric behavior emerges. Ben-Ari and Miller (2016) developed a probabilistic framework that also produce similar results, but their approach requires more advanced

item.title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
item.description: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.

item.title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
item.description: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.

item.title: 钻石极大算子：分类、模数和振荡包络线
item.description: We study maximal averages generated by bounded cancellative kernels taking values in finite-dimensional real normed spaces, on Euclidean balls and on balls in a non-Archimedean local field with a fixed uniformizer. For angular kernels, pointwise domination of the full maximal operators is equivalent to factorization of their angular averaging maps, with the same optimal constant. Nonzero scalar angular comparison classes are therefore projective kernel classes. For angular kernels constant on a fixed finite measurable partition of the direction space, symmetric convex bodies classify exact norm measurements, Grassmannians parametrize nonzero classes under mutual domination, and positive semidefinite Gram matrices classify Hilbert-valued measurements. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. A dilation example exhibits identifications of residue kernels beyond scaling and unit-coordinate changes. For nonzero radial residue kernels on bounded inputs, mutual domination is classified by the unit-circle zeros

item.title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
item.description: 令 $\chi$ 为与给定实二次场 $k$ 关联的导体 $N$ 的二次狄利克雷特征，并令 $X_\chi(N)$ 为与 $\chi$ 关联的 $X_0(N)$ 的双重覆盖。在本文中，我们研究曲线 $X_\chi(N)$ 上的模块化单元 $f$。我们证明$f$通过Fricke对合$\mathscr{w}_N$的变换是Lee和Park引入的Rogers-Ramanujan连续分数的$N$级类似物。此外，如果 $N$ 是正素判别式，那么 $f$ 就是 Ligozat 的模单元，这是从 Mazur 关于爱森斯坦理想的工作中得知的。我们将 Ligozat 的构造扩展到任何正的基本判别式 $N$。

item.title: $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$ 的精确欧几里得窗口
item.description: Let $R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$, let $\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$, and let $\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ be the prime ideal above $2$. Cavallar and Lemmermeyer studied the multiplicative weighted norms $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ and asked for which weights $t$ they are Euclidean functions on $R$. We show that the set of these weights, the Euclidean window of $\mathfrak{p}$, is $(\sqrt{5},T]$, where $T$ is the algebraic number \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots. \] Thus the window is nonempty but not open. We also obtain the integer-valued completely multiplicative Euclidean function $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$ on $R$.

item.title: Hecke 群的马尔可夫谱
item.description: 我们研究索引 $q\ge 5$ 的赫克群马尔可夫谱的初始离散部分。使用与测地线相关的数字扩展和 Perron 型公式，我们对马尔科夫值位于或低于第一个累积点的所有双无限数字序列进行分类。我们获得了离散谱值的显式公式，并识别了实现它们的序列，包括那些达到第一个累积点的序列。我们还证明了离散值的无限族严格增加到这一点。我们的结果通过明确的符号方法恢复了 Vulakh 对初始离散光谱的描述。

item.title: 平面点集中几乎空的单色多边形
item.description: 对于整数 $r \ge 3$、$c \ge 2$ 和 $s \ge 0$，设 $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ 表示最小整数，使得平面上的任何一组至少 $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,s)$ 点处于一般位置（一条线上没有三个点），用 $c$ 颜色着色，包含单色 $r$-gon （不一定是凸的）最多有 $s$ 内点。将 $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$ 定义为满足 $\mathsf{M}_r^{\star}(c,\lambda_r^{\star}(c)) < \infty$ 的最小整数。三角形的情况，即$r=3$，近年来得到了研究。在本文中，我们在 $\lambda_r^{\star}(c)$ 上建立边界，对于 $r \ge 4$。具体来说，在双色情况下，我们证明对于每个 $r\geq3$，$\lambda_r^{\star}(2)\leq \lfloor\frac{r-2}{2}\rfloor$。对于六边形，我们将这个边界锐化为$\lambda_6^{\star}(2)\leq1$，也就是说，一般位置上每个足够大的双色平面点集都包含一个最多有一个内点的单色六边形。接下来，对于任意数量的颜色 $c\geq3$ 和 $r\geq3$，我们显示 $$(r - 2) \left \lfloor \frac{c-1}{2} \right \rfloor \leq \lambda_r^\star(c) \leq (r-2)(c-2)+\left\lfloor(r-2)\delta_c

item.title: Unranking $S$-avoiding permutations with two forbidden offsets
item.description: 给定一个具有总顺序的有限组合对象族，排序要求给定对象的位置，而取消排序则要求占据给定位置的对象。两者都提供了对太大而无法枚举的族的算法访问。 Kagey 给出了几个位置受限族的多项式时间算法，并保留了 $\{-1,1\}$ 避免排列的情况。我们证明当 $|S| = 2$，禁止方块的图是$2$-正则，循环的不相交并集，固定前缀只留下路径和未触及的循环。这会为每个偏移量的二元素集生成多项式时间前缀计数、排序和取消排序，覆盖 $\{-1,1\}$。相同的结构给出了一个简短的证明，即对于奇数 $n$，$\{-1,1\}$ 避免排列的数量等于第 $n$-th m\'enage 数，对于偶数 $n$ 则超过 $2$，从而证明了 OEIS 条目 A354152 中记录的猜想。

item.title: 平面盘滤波器和 Beraha 数的实色根
item.description: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. Closing a grid of such disks between two poles produces a sphere triangulation, and a fused Temperley-Lieb trace identity accounts for its chromatic polynomial completely, sector by sector, with no appeal to semisimplicity at the root of unity itself -- generic semisimplicity enters only through polynomial identities continued from $\delta>2$ -- and no singular higher Jones-Wenzl projectors. item.title: 来自规定自同构搜索的二进制常量码的新下界，以及满足其上限的两个量子码
item.description: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on $A(n,6,w)$ in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$, $A(28,6,9)\ge 11388$ and $A(27,6,13)\ge 27783$, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second. item.title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$ and $P(n,4)$
item.description: 我们证明，对于每个 $n\ge13$，$Z(P(n,3))=8$ 和对于每个 $n\ge18$，$Z(P(n,4))=10$，两个稳定阈值都很尖锐，并给出所有较小的允许 $n$ 的精确值。第一个等式证明了克里希南猜想5；他的命题 4 提供了它的上限。下界使用第一强制源的外部边界：对于 $n\ge14$，十个顶点在 $P(n,3)$ 中具有至少八个边界，对于 $n\ge20$，十六个顶点在 $P(n,4)$ 中具有至少十个边界。空列间隔内的删除将这些断言减少为有限的检查，并解决剩余的情况。 $k=3$ 稳定定理具有 Lean 4 形式化； $k=4$ 证明使用 89 个边界公式和 11 个堡垒公式以及单独检查的 DRAT 证书，以及显式的强制序列。

item.title: PArcK 树可以变得很热
item.description: 我们将组合游戏 Partizan Arc Kayles 视为 Domineering 的概括。使用遗传算法进行的广泛技术搜索发现温度超过 2 的热点位置。我们讨论该搜索并构建包含这些图的高温位置族，并证明 Partizan Arc Kayles 具有无界温度。我们确定了无限系列的第二玩家获胜位置作为我们主要构建的一部分。

item.title: The Kemeny-Braess Paradox in Random Graphs
item.description: 2016 年，Kirkland 和 Zeng 使用 Kemeny 常数作为旅行时间的度量，开始对图上随机游走的 Braess 悖论进行数学处理。我们针对 Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi 随机图 $G(n,p)$ 研究这种现象。如果连通图中的一条边的删除保留了连通性并减小了 Kemeny 常数，则该边称为 Kemeny-Braess；如果插入增加了 Kemeny 常数，则非边称为 Kemeny-Braess。设$\bar d=(n-1)p$为$G\sim G(n,p)$的期望度，并假设$\bar d-\log n\to\infty$，因此$G$以高概率连接。我们确定了两种类型的悖论行为存在的尖锐渐近阈值。对于 $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$，Kemeny-Braess 边的阈值是 $\bar d=C^*\log n$，而 Kemeny-Braess 非边的阈值是 $\bar d=2C^*\log n$。因此，随着预期度 $\bar d$ 的增加，连通状态呈现出三个阶段：首先，Kemeny-Braess 悖论在边和非边上都发生，然后仅在非边上发生，最后消失。特别是，在密集状态下，$G$ 很可能没有 Kemeny-Braess edg

item.title: 带符号图的能量和顶点覆盖数
item.description: 有符号图 $\Gamma=(G,\sigma)$ 的能量 $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)$ 是其邻接矩阵 $A(\Gamma)$ 的特征值绝对值之和。在本文中，我们证明$\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)\geq 2\tau(G)$，其中$\tau(G)$是$G$的顶点覆盖数。无符号图的情况是这个结果的一个特例，这是一个 20 世纪 80 年代的猜想，直到最近才被证明。此外，我们完全描述了等式情况：当且仅当 $\Gamma$ 的每个连通分量都等价于 \emph{additive rook graph} $\Rook_N(a,b)$ 时，等式成立。该图是在 $N\times N$ 板上构建的，$a_i+b_j$ 顶点位于正方形 $(i,j)$ 上。如果两个顶点仅共享行，则通过正边连接；如果两个顶点仅共享列，则通过负边连接。结果，我们获得了极值有符号图的平衡/反平衡三分法，并推导出极值无符号图的表征。最后，一个示例表明该界限不会扩展到混合图的埃尔米特邻接矩阵或复杂的单位增益图。

item.title: Invariants of big classes from asymptotic total Betti numbers
item.description: 我们引入并研究了正态复射影簇上大线束的一个新的数值不变量，它是根据与线束的高张量幂相关的超曲面的总 Betti 数来定义的。我们证明这个不变量是双有理的，并提供了线束体积的上限。当大线丛允许有理 Zariski 分解时，我们证明不变量与体积一致。特别是，当线束充足或定义在投影表面上时，这一点成立。我们还研究了实代数环境中的类似问题，证明了与大线丛的高张量幂相关的实代数超曲面的存在，该线丛的实消失轨迹具有任意大的总贝蒂数。

item.title: 阿贝尔曲面上Brill-Noether轨迹的余维数和第一Segre不变量
item.description: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces. Specifically, for $\mathbf{v}$ a Mukai vector of a $\mu$-stable sheaf of $\mathrm{rank}\geq 2$, we compute the Segre invariant of the general sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$, and we determine the numbers which arise as the Segre invariant of a sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$.

item.title: 孤立超曲面奇点的丘几何猜想
item.description: 本文提出了长期存在的丘几何猜想的证明。

item.title: 超奇异阿贝尔簇的导出等价性和同源性
item.description: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic. We also give conditions under which derived equivalence between two supersingular principally polarized abelian varieties implies that their underlying abelian varieties are isomorphic. In particular, this implication holds in dimensions at most three.

item.title: On the classification of threefold flops
item.description: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements. We also show that derived contraction algebras admit a deformation-theoretic interpretation in families in a general setting that encompasses threefold flops, flips, and divisor-to-curve contractions.

item.title: 阿尔普奥格对JC的反例、经济稳定和赵氏消失猜想
item.description: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.

item.title: 允许有理同源盘平滑的加权齐次表面奇点
item.description: We study rational homology disk smoothings through canonical-cover representations and specialization of reflexive canonical powers, and recover the known dual graph and analytic classification. The geometric-genus representation of the canonical covering group, together with its complex conjugate, is a direct summand of the reduced regular representation. Specialization forces the canonical Riemann--Roch corrections to vanish; explicit formulas give equations for the Seifert invariants. For three arms and central weight two, these equations, the character restrictions, and the numerical identities determine the Seifert data without assuming the existence of a smoothing. Projective compactifications treat the remaining cases, and elliptic pencils explain the four-arm attachment points and the parameter independence of their cross ratios. We construct strong $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein smoothings for all listed analytic structures by deforming canonical-cover equations and lifting generators of the full first syzygy module. The numerical Milnor formula gives rational homology disk fibers.

item.title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
item.description: 令 $k/\mathbb Q$ 是有限生成的，令 $g\geq3$ 和 $n\geq1$ ，并令 $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ 为具有 $n$ 不同有序标记的平滑真属 $g$ 曲线的模堆栈。输入$K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$。我们证明了格洛腾迪克关于 $K$ 上通用 $n$ 指向的亏格-$g$ 曲线的截面猜想。在模堆栈及其函数域上，通用完全曲线的算术基本群扩展的连续部分，直到几何共轭，正是 $n$ 同义反复部分。对于每个素数 $\ell$，每个几何上的商 $\ell$ 都适用相同的分类。连同 Hain 对有理点的确定，这些分类给出了在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限生成的域的示例，其中具有全截面猜想成立的任何规定的正数有理点。该证明建立在 Hain 的加权完成和非阿贝尔上同调方法的基础上，并通过超椭圆计算提供了属三输入。积分归一化引理和移动标记参数从单能部分传递到几何上的 pro-$\ell$ 部分。 C

item.title: 实格拉斯曼函数内蕴Fr\’echet均值的中心极限定理
item.description: 子空间值数据出现在降维、图像集和视频识别以及信号处理中，Fr'echet 均值是它们的标准样本均值 [11,9,15,23]。我们为 i.i.d. 的内在样本 Fr'echet 均值建立了中心极限定理。对实格拉斯曼流形 $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$ 的观察，作为[18]一般定理的专门化。与之前的结果不同，之前的结果要求分布消失或在总体平均值的切割轨迹附近放置可忽略不计的质量，我们允许连续的、可能为正的密度。为了获得我们的结果，我们推导出 $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$ 的两个属性：第一个是均值距离 $\delta$ 内所有点的切割轨迹的并集具有体积 $O(\delta)$。第二个是平方距离函数的 Hessian 矩阵是可积的。我们还给出了 $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ 上的平滑密度，其均值是唯一的，但 Fr\'echet Hessian 消失了。

item.title: 高维中心极限定理中的最优维度增长率
item.description: 我们研究了在四阶矩存在下，半空间、欧氏球和 Borel 凸集上高维中心极限定理 (CLT) 的最优维数增长率。在文献中观察到，$d=o(n^c)$ 且 $0< c\leq 1/2$ 足以使 CLT 保持在欧几里得球之上。因此，理想情况下，超过一半空间的 CLT 应保持在类似的尺寸增长率下。然而，对于 Borel 凸集，$d= o(n^{c})$ 且 $0< c\leq 2/5$ 通常就足够了。欧几里得球和 Borel 凸集上的 CLT 的最新结果（分别为 $d= o(\sqrt{n})$ 和 $d= o(n^{2/5})$ 是由 Fang 和 Koike (2024) 在第四矩存在的情况下得出的。在本文中，我们研究了 $d$ 相对于 $n$ 的这些足够的增长率是否也是必要的。因此，我们的结果完全表征了在半空间、欧几里得球和 Borel 凸集上存在四阶矩的情况下维度增长率的锐度。

item.title: 两个相关均匀随机变量的总和：联合尾边界的表征
item.description: 当两个均匀随机变量如何相互依赖一无所知时，它们的总和可以有哪些定律？对于三个或更多均匀被加数，凸阶给出答案；对于两个人来说，情况并非如此，而且这个问题一直悬而未决。我们证明，可达到的定律正是满足尾部概率和的一系列显式联合界限的定律，每个有限阈值集都有一个界限。对于密度最多为 1 的定律，仅由凸阶决定。对于密度最多为 2 的情况，凸阶意味着最简单的联合边界，并且对于单阈值边界不能提高常数 2。定律所需的阈值数量是由其原子的间距决定的，而不是由其拥有的原子数量决定的。

item.title: G$\beta$E 的 CLT 中几乎最优的批量正则性条件
item.description: We consider linear statistics $\sum_{k=1}^N f(x_k)$ of a Gaussian $\b$-ensemble. Following the work of \cite{LaSo22}, which was concerned only with Wigner matrices, we extend their results for general $\b$. In particular, we show that the CLT holds for any $f \in H^{1/2 + \e}$. The novel input which was not used in \cite{LaSo22} is the Helffer-Sj\"ostrand representation for the covariance, first appearing the random matrix context in \cite{ErYa15}, coupled with characteristic flow estimates for DBM, first appearing in \cite{Bo22}.

item.title: $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上多模态分布的 Langevin AIS 快速收敛
item.description: 我们研究了由过阻尼朗之万扩散驱动的退火重要性采样（AIS），目标是低温 $\varepsilon$ 上 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上的多模态吉布斯测度 $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$。对于具有非简并临界点的潜在 $U$、有限多个具有可比质量的井以及至少在无穷远处二次增长，我们表明，具有谐波间隔温度计划的 AIS 会产生一个加权经验测量，该加权经验测量将 $\pi_\varepsilon$ 近似到精确度 $\delta$，总成本为 $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$，直至对数因子，并且指数不依赖于维度。与普通的朗之万蒙特卡罗相比，这是指数级的改进，其弛豫时间遵循阿伦尼乌斯定律。这些假设特别涵盖高斯混合物的潜力，只要它们的临界点是非简并的并且它们的井具有相当的质量。该分析将 arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] 的分析从环面 $\mathbb{T}^d$ 扩展到非紧状态空间 $\mathbb{R}^d$。这两个新成分是在特征函数上的加权$L^\infty$

item.title: 混合下扰动晶格的空洞概率
item.description: 我们研究具有可能相关扰动的静止扰动晶格的空洞概率。我们的主要结果给出了两个成分的一般上限：具有均匀正概率命中观察集的晶格位置的数量，以及扰动场的 $\alpha$ 混合率。对于格立方的并集，这会产生显式边界，而无需对扰动的边际分布进行矩或规律性假设。因此，我们获得了具有非空内部的增长有界 Borel 集的定量估计，包括指数混合下的拉伸指数衰减和多项式混合下的多项式衰减。

item.title: On the Proportion of Time that a Conventional Confidence Interval Covers
item.description: 近年来，置信序列或“任意置信区间”的概念引起了人们的极大兴趣。这就引发了这样一个问题：在进行类似评估时，传统置信区间的表现如何。特别是，当采样所花费的总时间 $n$ 很大时，我们研究了传统置信区间程序覆盖总体平均值的时间比例的概率分布。我们建立了极限分布的不变性原理，因为 $n$ 趋于无穷大，并证明极限随机变量 $Z(1)$ 可以表示为布朗运动的函数。随机变量 $Z(1)$ 表现出尺度不变性，可以与 $t=1$ 处的布朗运动联合推导 $Z(1)$ 密度的偏微分方程 (PDE)，即 $B(1)$。我们证明，这种密度也可以计算为二维奇异扩散的平稳分布，其中一个组成部分是奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程。然后我们推导出一个近似马尔可夫链，它允许我们对偏微分方程进行数值求解。这种密度有许多有趣的壮举

item.title: Probabilistic large deviations approach to obstacle Hamilton-Jacobi equations
item.description: In this paper, we derive a non-classical variational representation of a viscosity solution of a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with obstacle, in which the Hamiltonian may take infinite values. We study a nonlinear selection-mutation model with an exponential-decay mutation kernel, using a probabilistic Feynman-Kac representation of a pure jump process. To handle the singular character of this process, we rely on a non-standard tool from large deviations theory, which allows us to establish a Varadhan-type lemma. This, in turn, yields the variational representation of the viscosity solution.

item.title: Reusable QUBO-Derived Block-Schur Inverse Factors for Fixed-Operator Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
item.description: Many simulations of partial differential equations require the repeated solution of linear systems whose matrix remains fixed while the righthand side changes. We present a hybrid offline online framework for this setting. The discretized operator is organized into small coupled blocks and reduced through block Schur complements. Instead of expressing the complete PDE solution as one large binary optimization problem, quadratic unconstrained binary optimization is used only to construct reusable local inverse factors. These factors are computed during an offline stage, decoded and stored, and then reused in an ordinary classical block solve for subsequent righthand sides. The optimizer facing problem size is governed by the local block size and chosen numerical precision, rather than by the dimension of the full spatial grid. We develop the mathematical formulation, analyze the accuracy and resource requirements of the binary representation, and examine the method on representative finite difference PDE problems, including execution of the local optimization stage on quantum optimization hardware. The resulting architecture provides a

item.title: 经过认证的抛物线障碍问题的神经近似
item.description: 残差训练的神经代理没有错误保证，这是对相变和接触等自由边界问题的限制。我们推导出一阶状态-通量-乘数形式的抛物线障碍问题的神经逼近的保证误差界。主要结果通过本构残差、初始失配、互补缺陷和由 $c_F^2/\alpha$ 加权的 PDE 残差来限制网络的通量误差及其可行投影 $\max\{v,g\}$ 的能量误差，而无需一阶公式的矫顽力和范数等价常数。它将热算子的 Apushkinskaya-Repin 主线扩展到一般系数、自由乘子和通量约束。渗透一致性结果表明存在任意小边界的神经三元组。外向舍入的单元泰勒模型外壳将界限转变为对任何自适应分区有效的有限计算。经认证，投影输出的通量和梯度误差低于一维 Stefan 问题的解决方案规模的 0.27 美元和 0.33 美元，并且在自适应细化之后，低于所有 t 的二分之一。

item.title: 关于钳位 B 样条矩形 Schoenberg-Whitney 定理的注记
item.description: Wang等人（Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008）提出了矩形B样条配置矩阵的全行秩的结子序列表征。我们在附录证明中发现了一个不正确的不等式，这使得所写的论证无效，并明确了标准所依赖的端点和多重性约定。缺陷在于证明，而不在于潜在的结果，该结果在适当陈述的假设下是有效的；在王等人的放样施工中。这些假设得到隐式满足，因此放样曲线不受影响。我们陈述了修正后的结果，并给出了一个新的证明，独立于有争议的论点，对于具有连续内部重数的任意阶的钳位 B 样条。在我们的证明中，充分性源于包含样条空间和结插入；必要性选择独立的列并从中构建简化的结向量。该证明不使用递归列选择结构。

item.title: 时变Ginzburg--Landau方程的规范不变有限元方法
item.description: It is well known that the Ginzburg--Landau equations are gauge invariant. The most popular gauge choice in practical simulations is the temporal gauge, also known as the zero electric potential gauge. However, the commonly used N\'ed\'elec approximations may produce spurious giant vortices on domains with re-entrant corners. To address this issue while retaining the N\'ed\'elec approximation, we propose a finite element scheme that preserves the gauge invariance of the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations at the discrete level. Under the temporal gauge, the method employs lowest-order N\'ed\'elec edge elements for the magnetic potential and continuous piecewise-linear elements for the order parameter on triangular and tetrahedral meshes, and yields a linear, decoupled formulation that requires only the solution of linear systems at each time step. We prove that the scheme is gauge invariant, preserves a discrete maximum bound principle for the order parameter, $\|\psi_h^n\|_{L^\infty(\Omega)}\le 1$, and satisfies a discrete energy law under mild step-size and mesh conditions. Numerical experiments confirm these theoretical proper

item.title: The Segal-Bargmann Transform in Neural Partial Differential Equations
item.description: We introduce a novel neural operator method based on Segal-Bargmann transform and Bargmann-Fock space for learning the solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). The method brings data encoding, latent-space representation, operator learning, and decoding into an unifed framework. From only finitely many observations, we establish a sup-norm reconstruction error of order $ L^{-\frac{1}{2}} $, where L is the number of complex sampling points that are decoupled with the original samplings and observations. The reconstruction error is independent of the spatial dimension and the number of original sampling points. We show that this new mesh-free Segal-Bargmann Neural Operator approach has superior performance compared to existing NO approaches like FNO, BelNet, GNOT, etc.,\ particularly in terms of pointwise control $ \sup_{x}\lvert\hat{u}_{NO} - u_{truth}\rvert $ for solutions of PDEs $ \mathcal{L}u = f $ which provides pointwise accuracy and interpretability as classical numerical solvers. We also demonstrates the reconstructions of the solution operators for higher dimensional nonlinear PDEs, which suggest that our p

item.title: 可压缩反应流方程的斜对称公式和能量稳定方案
item.description: 本文为反应式欧拉方程和反应式纳维-斯托克斯方程开发了斜对称公式和能量稳定有限差分格式。通过引入合适的变换变量，我们将控制方程重写为斜对称形式，并通过标准的分部积分参数获得连续能量估计。所提出的公式将可压缩流动方程的斜对称框架扩展到反应系统，其中化学能和物质方程必须纳入转换变量中。基于这些公式，我们使用分部求和（SBP）运算符构建半离散方案。对流项由线性迎风SBP算子的非耗散部分离散化，而非线性SBP--WENO算子仅用于在不连续点附近提供人工耗散。对于周期性边界条件，所得方案满足与连续分析一致的半离散能量估计。一维和二维空间维度的数值实验验证了设计的精度顺序，并证明了解决问题的稳定性能

item.title: 异质介质中空间相关变指数次扩散逆势问题的分析与逼近
item.description: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. We formulate the inverse problem as a nonlinear fixed-point equation and prove that the associated fixed-point operator is monotone such that the fixed-point iteration converges decreasingly to the unique solution. item.title: 具有声学边界条件的非线性耦合热弹性系统的数值分析
item.description: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $\theta$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $\delta$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $\beta(\int_\Omega\theta dx)\Delta\theta$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$ for space discretization. We demonstrate that the domain-boundary coupling induces a half-power loss in the spatial convergence order for the variable $u$, and this effect propagates to the remaining variables due to the thermoelastic and boundary couplings, resulting in the final error estimate $\mathcal{O}(h^{r+\frac{1}{2}} + \tau^2)$. A bootstrap argument is employed to ensure the uniform boundedness of $\|U_h^n\|_{L^\infty}$, which is essential for handling the nonlinearity. Numerical results using Lagrange f

item.title: 受 Kleene 启发的顺序系统，用于证据和真相的最小逻辑
item.description: This paper investigates the proof theory of the logic of evidence and truth LETFm, with the aim of obtaining a sequent calculus consisting only of logical rules, suitable for a simple bottom-up decision procedure. We begin with G1f, a sequent system containing structural rules, which makes explicit the main difficulties in obtaining a fully logical and decidable calculus for LETFm. We then introduce G3f, a G3-style system obtained from by applying Kleene's trick, which absorbs contraction into the logical rules by adding the principal formula of the rule to its premises.

item.title: Weakly uniform computable categoricity and function composition
item.description: We introduce the definition of a weakly $X$-uniformly $Y$-computably categorical structure, relativizing a definition of Kudinov (1996), and show that this relativized notion is closely related to the 2-dimensional complexity of the pairs of partial functions $(f,g)$ with the property that the composition $g\circ f$ simulates convergent $\emptyset'$-oracle computations. We develop a general theory for computing via composition and use it to prove results about the surprisingly complex weakly uniform categoricity spectrum of the structure $(\omega,S)$ where $S(n)=n+1$. Namely, that $(\omega,S)$ is w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for some $X\not\geq_T\emptyset'$ and $Y<_T\emptyset'$, but $(\omega,S)$ is not w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for any $X<_T\emptyset'$ and $Y\not\geq_T\emptyset'$. We also construct a computably categorical structure that is not w.$\emptyset'$.u.c.c., but is w.$X$.u.c.c. for a set $X$ that is $\leq_T$-incomparable with $\emptyset'$.

item.title: Short proof that Vop\v{e}nka's Principle is symmetrically stable
item.description: 我们证明了 Vop\v{e}nka 原理在对称扩展下是稳定的。最近，de Groot 和 Woloszyn [1] 证明了这一事实。我们发现这个定理的证明不必要地复杂。在这篇简短的文章中，我们证明了同样的说法。我们引导读者参考 [3] 来了解对称扩展。

item.title: 链产品模型理论
item.description: 我们证明，关于与线性阶有限乘积同构的分配格的模型理论性质，存在显着的对称性：如果 ${\mathbb X}_i$, $i1$, ${\mathcal T}:=\mathop{\rm Th}\nolimits (\prod _{i1$ 是一阶可定义的。

item.title: 可计算可枚举集合中成员资格的一致性强度模式
item.description: 自然数上的每个可计算先序关系都是某个可计算可枚举集 $A$ 中的成员资格断言“$n\in A$”的一致性强度的顺序。此外，对于每个可计算可枚举理论列表 $T_0,T_1,T_2,\ldots$，每个扩展 PA，都有一个可计算可枚举集合 $A$，使得每个 $T_n$ 在 PA 上与 A$ 中的成员资格断言 $n\in 等一致。当使用非成员资格断言 $n\notin A$ 时，这两个结果也类似。

item.title: 限制除法和全除法的等价
item.description: 我们通过 $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ 证明，限制欧几里得除法原理 $\mathrm{pa17}^{-}$（仅对互素对进行除法）等价于完整原理 $\mathrm{pa17}$。该证明使用一种变换，保留除法中的商与余数，以将互素对的任意除法问题简化为一个。这回答了 Visser 的开放问题 8.29，并表明限制原理与 $\mathrm{PA}^{-}$ 上的完整欧几里得除法具有相同的强度。

item.title: 一个健全的纯类型系统，具有排序和类型输入
item.description: 我们提出了一个依赖类型的纯类型系统，它包含一个循环公理 $s : s$ 对于某种类型 $s$ 并且仍然是强规范化的。避免了吉拉德悖论，因为我们的排序不是在 $\Pi$-former 下封闭的：函数类型根据其等级进行排序。事实证明，该系统具有一组独特的特征：它具有与 STLC 类似的归一化行为（因此归一化的复杂性是 TOWER-complete），同时允许任意基本递归函数的非均匀表示；此外，它在 ZF+GCH 中具有非平凡的集合论模型，并允许进行非平凡的证明开发。基本规范化证明非常简单（纯类型系统的模一般元理论属性），并且已在 vanilla Rocq（以前称为 Coq）中完全形式化，无需额外的公理。

item.title: 紧密 $C^{(2)}$ 紧凑基数上的身份危机
item.description: Bagaria 和 Goldberg 问，对于自然数 $n\ge 1$，$\kappa$ 是否紧密 $C^{(n)}$ 紧凑意味着 $\kappa\in C^{(n+1)}$ ？ Usuba 对 $n=1$ 给出了否定答案。在本文中，我们对 $n=2$ 给出否定答案。

item.title: 事半功倍：代理计算相对于替代架构选择的适用性的第一性原理探索
item.description: 由于代理人工智能 (AI) 看似易于使用，因此人们对利用代理人工智能 (AI) 实现业务活动自动化越来越感兴趣。花更多的钱做更少的事情从未如此简单或成本更高。然而，人们对代理何时优于本地计算、表述性状态传输 (REST)、简单对象访问协议 (SOAP) 和模型上下文协议 (MCP) 等已建立的替代方案知之甚少，特别是在考虑开发速度、性能和运营成本时。我们使用受控数学任务来研究这个问题，该任务在 1,000 个算术表达式的基准上比较七种方法，其中必须保留运算符优先级的语义。我们在本机函数调用基线（Python 库）、REST、SOAP 和 MCP 微服务架构、使用 Groq 云 API 和五个本地部署的 Ollama 模型的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的直接响应，以及五个本地 LLM 调用 MCP 工具的代理系统中运行此设置。确定性方法可实现 100% 的准确度，并且延迟可以忽略不计。直接 LLM 评估的准确率最高可达 92.9%

item.title: 统一多范式融合智能罕见病诊断
item.description: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis.
